title: Once Upon a Time in Gielinor: Flashback
start: Talk to Closure in his office to find out more. It can be accessed through Death's Realm.
prereq_quests: Once Upon a Time in Gielinor: Foreshadowing

steps.t: Talk to Closure who can be found in the Closure's Study in Death's office. [Chat: Accept]
Watch the cutscene.
Talk to the bartender in the Blue Moon Inn for the handwritten message. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Read the handwritten message.
Head to the Jolly Boar Inn located north-east of Varrock, outside the city walls near the Infernal source digsite and the Fort Forinthry lodestone.
p: Relomia in the Jolly Boar Inn.

steps.t: Talk to Relomia at the bar for a stack of Closure's biographies.
Return and talk to Closure with his biographies.
Talk to Merlin in the waiting room of Closure's office to enter his memory.
Interact with the Oneiric manipulator in your inventory to play the memory. [Chat: 1 Play the memory]
Interact with it again to reset the memory. [Chat: 2 Reset the memory]
Interact with the NPC next to you (shares your character's name). [Chat: 3 Excalibur]
Interact with the Latsyrc crystal twice so it becomes a Giant crystal.
Interact with the 'Merlin sucks' shield on the western wall once so it becomes a Wallshield.
Interact with the Oneiric manipulator in your inventory again. [Chat: 1 Play the memory]
Once back in Closure's office, talk to Merlin.
Talk to Ozan to enter his memory.
Interact with the Oneiric manipulator in your inventory to play the memory. [Chat: 1 Play the memory]
Interact with the Oneiric manipulator to reset the memory. [Chat: 2 Reset the memory]
Interact with Ozan. [Chat: 2 Jump second.]
Interact with the NPC that shares your character name. [Chat: 1 Jump first.]
Enter the portal and interact the empty cart once so it becomes a cart.
p: Rocks fall on Ava and the player.

steps.t: Interact with the Oneiric manipulator in your inventory. [Chat: 1 Play the memory]
Once back in Closure's office, talk to Ozan.
Talk to Ava to enter her memory.
Interact with the Oneiric manipulator to play the memory. [Chat: 1 Play the memory]
Interact with the Oneiric manipulator. [Chat: 2 Reset the memory]
Interact with NPC that shares your character's name. [Chat: 2 Undead chickens]
Investigate Lever B on the wall twice so it becomes a lever.
Investigate the Spooky clock twice so it becomes a wardrobe.
Interact with the Oneiric manipulator again. [Chat: 1 Play the memory]
Once back in Closure's office, talk to Ava.
Talk to Closure.
